I replied to Nadia in the #strategic-pod thread: Gideon landed on **280 seats** for Vantorre Group.

His July 1 update first said 300. A few minutes later he corrected it to 280. The 300 had included sandbox logins from their May rollout, and 280 is the active production roster as of July 1. Ruth acknowledged the 280 in the channel.

I also told her it's a July 1 snapshot, so the number may have moved since. I only read #strategic-pod, which Nadia is a member of.
